_arch_note: ARM B AT 16K — LightMultiHeadLUT with the normalised confidence gate (lut_impl="light", lut_forward_confidence=true, lut_confidence_form="bounded_norm") on the full 16,000-step schedule. Config cloned verbatim from exp_n_0129 (grid_H4d48_nap8_tph256, the 16k member of this LUT sizing); the ONLY deltas are lut_impl, the two gate keys and exp_name — random_seed was already 1. Light detaches the routing address (sign(d).detach(), no STE, no temperature surrogate), so x receives gradient ONLY through the confidence score; multi_head_input is auto-enabled, so the projections and table budget match Fast exactly and the only structural difference is the missing directional surrogate. Light has no learnable temperatures, hence exactly 12 parameters fewer than exp_n_0129 (2 per layer x 6 layers): 105,100,416 vs 105,100,428. DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE 4K ARM B (exp_n_0181): lut_inner_in_dim stays at this family's 48 rather than arm B's 32, buying like-for-like comparability with exp_n_0129 at the cost of exact faithfulness to the 4k run; d_in affects only the compress projection, not the table budget. WHY THIS RUN: at 4k, arm B scored 1.477708 against a vanilla-dense zero-line of 1.474749 — +0.003, INSIDE the 0.0096 seed sd — so Light matched dense quality with a 5.6x cheaper backward. This tests whether that holds at the full budget, against exp_n_0129 (Fast, gate off) 1.170961 and vanilla dense 1.165147 / 1.161798 (vanilla seed spread 0.00335). Trained with train_fixed.py, so the training-time eval IS the corrected protocol (evaluate_bpb_fixed, bs48 x 100, skip 12, 2,451,456 val tokens). NOTE: the inherited "eval_steps": 10 and "compute_dtype": "bf16" keys are INERT — eval_config() reads only an optional `fixed_eval` sub-dict (absent here), and compute_dtype has exactly one reference in the codebase, the line in make_sweep.py that writes it. Tables are fp32 (lut_use_bf16 false), which matters because _embedding_bag_per_sample_weights_backward_cuda is not implemented for bf16.
